title: Check in system for clients
description:
We require the following new endpoints for clients:
'getCheckIns', 'addCheckIn', 'deleteCheckIn', 'updateCheckIn' .
There needs to be a new model "UserCheckIn" which needs to be stored in its own table.

Each user when setting up their profile for the first time must be required to provide a 'timezone' information that will be stored against their profile. They can also update this information via the standard profile update. It'll be used to calculate the start date for the UserCheckIns (the clients will do so).

The models are the following:
UserCheckIn {
 id: UUID, //generated by db
 userId: UUID, //reference to a user
 start: Date, //timestamp in iso form when the check in starts
 frequency: UserCheckInFrequency,
 metadata: any,
createdAt: Date, //generated by db on insert
updatedAt: Date //generated by db on insert and update
}
UserCheckInFrequency enum { DAILY, WEEKLY, BIWEEKLY, MONTHLY, OTHER }

features.title: Add Timezone Field to User Profile
features.description: Update the user profile model, DTOs, and repository to include a mandatory `timezone` string field. This field is required during profile creation and is optionally updatable. This involves modifying `user-profile.interface.ts`, `create-profile.dto.ts`, `update-profile.dto.ts`, `user-profile.dto.ts`, and `dynamodb-user-profiles.repository.ts`.

features.title: Create UserCheckIn Model and Interfaces
features.description: In a new `src/check-ins/interfaces` directory, create `user-check-in.interface.ts` to define the `UserCheckIn` interface and the `UserCheckInFrequency` enum (DAILY, WEEKLY, BIWEEKLY, MONTHLY, OTHER).

features.title: Implement Repository for UserCheckIn
features.description: Create the repository layer for `UserCheckIn` persistence in a new `src/check-ins/repositories` directory. This includes an `ICheckInsRepository` interface and a `DynamoDbCheckInsRepository` implementation with methods for creating, finding, updating, and deleting check-ins. Also define a corresponding injection token in `src/check-ins/tokens.ts`.

features.title: Create Check-In Service, Module, and DTOs
features.description: Create the `check-ins.service.ts` to handle business logic, `check-ins.module.ts` to wire dependencies, and necessary DTOs (`create-check-in.dto.ts`, `update-check-in.dto.ts`, `check-in.dto.ts`) with validation and Swagger decorators in a new `src/check-ins` directory.

features.title: Create Check-In Controller with API Endpoints
features.description: Implement `check-ins.controller.ts` with endpoints for `getCheckIns` (GET /check-ins), `addCheckIn` (POST /check-ins), `updateCheckIn` (PATCH /check-ins/:id), and `deleteCheckIn` (DELETE /check-ins/:id). Secure the endpoints and add full Swagger documentation.

features.title: Update Database Seed Script for UserCheckIns Table
features.description: Modify the `scripts/seed_database` file to add a new `aws dynamodb create-table` command for the `UserCheckIns` table. The table schema should use `userId` as the partition key and `id` as the sort key.

features.title: Update Project Documentation for Check-In Feature
features.description: Update `docs/FILE_ORGANISATION.md` to document the new `src/check-ins` module. Check for a `docs/DATABASE_INFO.md` file and if it exists, add the schema and access patterns for the new `UserCheckIns` table.
